verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or a first-party agent endpoint. The llms.txt file, the OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec and the REST API are developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
